about: Coped-beam block shear tests, numbers only, read by hand from the sources below for docs/coped_beam_check.md. Each specimen names its source and the table or figure each number came from.
extraction: single-family: one model family (Claude) read every source and typed every number. No second family checked the reading.

conventions.units: SI rows are mm, MPa and kN. US rows are in, ksi and kip.
conventions.lev: vertical distance from the top bolt row to the cope edge (the source's end distance)
conventions.leh: horizontal distance from the bolt line nearest the beam end to the beam end (the source's edge distance)
conventions.pitches: vertical spacings between bolt rows, top to bottom
conventions.gauge: horizontal spacing between the two bolt lines, null for one line
conventions.holes: rows with a hole on each line, line 1 nearest the beam end; omitted when every row has a hole on every line
conventions.hole: hole diameter; measured where hole_measured is true, else the standard hole for the bolt
conventions.slot: slot length along the tension plane, for horizontal slots
conventions.fy, fu: measured from coupons of the web
conventions.cope_length, cope_depth: the top cope, null where the source gives no number
conventions.rotation_deg: the beam end rotation the test imposed, null where the source imposes none or gives none
conventions.load: the largest vertical reaction on the tested connection
conventions.block_shear: true when the source reports a block shear failure at the largest load

SER244.cite: Franchuk, C. R., Driver, R. G. and Grondin, G. Y. (2002). Block shear behaviour of coped steel beams. Structural Engineering Report 244, University of Alberta.

BG1978.cite: Birkemoe, P. C. and Gilmor, M. I. (1978). Behavior of bearing critical double-angle beam connections. Engineering Journal 15(4), 109-115.

RY1983_via_IDEA.cite: Ricles, J. M. and Yura, J. A. (1983). Strength of double-row bolted-web connections. Journal of the Structural Division 109(1), 126-142. Not read. Numbers from IDEA StatiCa, Block shear rupture in bolted connections (AISC), verification page, Table 3 (Fy, Fu, tw), Table 4 (Pexp) and Figure 28 (geometry, a reproduction of the paper's specimen drawings).

KG2001.cite: Kulak, G. L. and Grondin, G. Y. (2001). AISC LRFD rules for block shear in bolted connections, a review. Engineering Journal 38(4), 199-203. Errata and addendum, Engineering Journal 39(2), 2002, 109-110.
